photo.credit: Guillaume Baviere from Helsingborg, Sweden, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: Nine volcanic islands, about 1,400 km west of mainland Portugal
worth_knowing: The islands run northwest to southeast for more than 600 km, in three groups. Mount Pico, the highest point in Portugal at 2,351 m, is on Pico island.
